data.name: Sample - IBM QRadar - 1.6.3
data.description: IBM QRadar is an enterprise security information and event management (SIEM) product. Fortinet FortiSOAR connector for IBM QRadar allows users to invoke QRadar API, perform Ariel Queries and operations like Get Offense,related events,update and close offenses.
